content:
emily: Heads-up — Acme Labs sending Dr. Patel at 3pm with a foldable mobility scooter + an insulated cooler with temperature-sensitive samples. Need plan for badging, storage, and a short seat for the visitor in the lobby. Pics in thread.

linda: Thanks Emily. Do we have a fridge option that meets chain-of-custody for samples? Or should we book the courier to hold?

sanjay: We shouldn't store medical samples in the kitchenette fridge. Also need an SDS / handling declaration from them. Can we ask them to bring a coldpack and the sample manifest?

emily: I already pinged their lab ops; they said it's benign assay controls, kept at 4C, will be on gel ice packs, <10kg total. They can bring SDS.

maya: We have the small locked medical fridge in mailroom B but it's used sometimes. I'll check availability. If it's free I can badge-lock it for the afternoon.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor scheduled: Dr. R. Patel (Acme Labs), 1 visitor, ETA 15:00, host: emily. Badge will be printed on arrival.

noah: Can we do a reserved visitor seat in the lobby? 3pm is tour time — might clash with the campus demo group.

linda: I'll hold the marble bench by reception for them and put a temporary sign. Also will prepare a temporary badge and "medical samples" note on the visitor form so security sees it.

maya: Mailroom B fridge is free 14:45–17:00. I can move a spare blanket cooler there and set temp to 4C. Need approval from ops.

sanjay: Approved from infra side. Just add it to the visitor log and request SDS. Also put a note: "Do not dispose / do not freeze."

emily: Awesome — can someone add a quick check-in script for front desk to follow? E.g.:
```
1) Verify SDS and manifest
2) Print visitor badge: add note "samples in mailroom B fridge"
3) Escort to lobby seating or to mailroom if they're dropping samples immediately
4) Sign chain-of-custody and log temperature on arrival
```

linda: Copying the script to the front desk playbook now. Also adding an accessible route note for the scooter (we'll keep the elevator keyed open).

noah: I'll keep a spare folding chair and a small ramp mat near reception just in case the scooter needs a quick fold/unfold area.

emily: Thank you all. I'll reply to Acme to ask for SDS + manifest and confirm arrival time. :heart: 

maya: Quick PSA for future visitors with mobility devices: if the scooter is foldable we can stow it in our guest locker but please specify dimensions ahead of time. Saves a ton of scrambling. :raised_hands:

linda: Front desk will flag any incoming guest with mobility needs as "Accessible arrival" in the calendar so we can prep.

emily: Last Q — any restriction on accepting food/edibles? Acme also said they might bring a small celebratory cake for the team. :)

sanjay: Cake fine. Medical samples still handled separately. Put cake in common fridge if uncut; otherwise the kitchenette is fine.

emily: Perfect. I'll confirm everything and update thread with any changes. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
